Laboratory and Industrial Suppliers Directory

LabDirectory is the independent directory of laboratory equipment suppliers, scientific supplies distributors, research reagent vendors, industrial supplies wholesalers and biotechnology service companies serving research laboratories and workshops across the United States. Universities, hospital laboratories, contract research organizations, manufacturers and biotech startups use the directory to locate suppliers of analytical instruments, chromatography consumables, chromatography columns, mass spectrometry services, cell culture media, lab reagents, fasteners, packaging materials and research chemicals.

Browse by category

  • Laboratory equipment — balances, centrifuges, incubators, chromatography systems
  • Scientific supplies and reagents — research reagents, fasteners, antibodies, buffers, solvents
  • Biotechnology services — sequencing, assay development, contract research
  • Laboratory services — calibration, analytical testing, conformance documentation
  • Industrial supplies and packaging — fasteners, shipping supplies, packaging materials, safety equipment

Featured suppliers in Oregon and Washington

Recently listed laboratory suppliers include Northern Lab Supply (Seattle), Pacific Reagents (Portland), Prairie Scientific (Boise) and Maritime Biotech (Tacoma). Each listing includes contact details, product lines and a link to the supplier's website.

Why list your laboratory business

Listings are free for laboratory and industrial suppliers in the United States. A listing includes your company description, website link, categories, service area and contact information. Our editorial team reviews every submission within five business days to keep the directory accurate and useful for the scientific and industrial community. We do not accept listings from companies outside the laboratory, life sciences and industrial supply sectors.

Updated October 20, 2026. Subscribe to our monthly newsletter for new supplier announcements and laboratory procurement tips.

About the directory

Founded in 2012 by laboratory managers in Portland, LabDirectory is maintained by a small editorial team with backgrounds in analytical chemistry and biochemistry. The directory is funded by optional premium listings and never by paid links. Read our about page, editorial policy and privacy policy.
